title: SET_OPTIONS fails with LOW_RESERVE inside a sponsorship sandwich in a fee bump, on mainnet
pattern: A fee bump whose inner transaction is a sponsorship sandwich: begin sponsoring, remove one signer, add another, end sponsoring. The sponsor lacks the reserve for the new signer, so operation 2 fails with low_reserve and the whole inner transaction fails (txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED). The inner result still lists every operation's code: the three others report success, although none of their effects were kept.

hazards.placement: SetOptionsResult.SET_OPTIONS_LOW_RESERVE at op index 2; the other ops report success in a failed tx
txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED with a four-op inner result on mainnet
sponsorship sandwich whose sponsored signer add fails for the sponsor's reserve

facts.says: The inner SET_OPTIONS at op index 2 fails with low_reserve.
Op 0 (begin sponsoring) still reports success in the failed inner transaction.
The failing op adds a signer with weight 20.
The inner result has four operation results.
